summary: npm package resolves sole dependency from non-registry host with install lifecycle script
details: merchantweb-lang-cookie-reset@0.999.999 declares a single dependency, packet-table-thread-stream, pointed at a direct tarball URL on artifacts.yosiroute.com rather than the npm registry, with no version pin and no integrity hash. The shrinkwrap records hasInstallScript: true for that dependency, so npm install of this package fetches and executes a lifecycle script from a tarball served by that third-party host. The wrapper's own code is trivial (index.js exports only a name/version literal) and the manifest uses placeholder metadata (author 'Package Registry', description 'Generated package', repository github.com/example/...), consistent with a thin redirector around the externally hosted payload rather than a real library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
